name: Network Preprocess
summary: App to preprocess connectivity/similarity matrices (conmat) and generate a filtered version of the network, which can be directed or undirected, weighted or unweighted.

parameters.description:
Choose how to handle the sign of the weights. 
Absolute: Uses the absolute value of entries as weights.
Positive: Uses only positive weights.
Negative: Set all negative weights to positive, and positive to zero weight.
Layered: Keep weights unchanged but adds separated layers for negative and positive.
None : Makes no changes to the signs of entries.
